title: Only the long bag actually fits a men's suit. You only get 1 x long bag + 4 short. :(
text: Only the long bag actually fits a men's suit. You only get 1 x long bag + 4 short. :(. This is a good value, but I found the short bags to be much too short for men's jackets/suits. The long bag was just right. I just wish all five were the longer bag--you get 4 short, and one long in this pack. Not cool. Also, this is definitely not a travel garment bag, in case you were thinking about using it that way. This is a dustproof closet storage bag, that's it.
